questionnaire_2026.Why I'm standing: I am asking you to give your party vote to ACT. I want more ACT MPs who will fight to cut waste and grow the country, balance the books with no new taxes, defend equal rights, deliver better public services, cut red tape, and restore real consequences for crime. I'm asking you to vote for whichever electorate candidate you believe will best represent your area and to give your party vote to ACT.
questionnaire_2026.About me: I'm a current Councillor, standing up against undemocratic co-governance arrangements. I've experienced the issues in councils that drive rates up while the services you receive in return aren't up to scratch. I'm standing list-only, so the best way to elect me and more of ACT's strong team is to party vote ACT: to Lock Labour Out, re-elect the coalition Government, and give ACT the strength to go further and faster in unlocking New Zealand's potential.
